events_detected.title: Iran war Day 182 — CENTCOM claims Hormuz 'open, momentum building'; Iran FM rejects ceasefire, demands 'end to war'; UN pauses evacuation after attack

UN shipping agency paused evacuation effort after vessel attacked in Gulf of Oman. Iran still able to 'largely keep Strait of Hormuz shut down' per WHRO. Oil revenue cut by $6B+ from blockade. events_detected.title: Japan's $96.5B intervention loses 61% of initial FX gain — Sept BOJ meeting critical, officials shift to targeted speculator-squeeze strategy
events_detected.description: TS2.tech: Japan's record ¥15.4T ($96.5B) intervention between July 30-Aug 26 has lost 61% of its initial FX gain. Officials abandoning habit of telegraphing intervention risks, shifting to 'targeted campaign to squeeze speculators and raise cost of betting against yen' (Reuters). BOJ July 30 intervention could have been as much as ¥9.6T single-day (surpassing ¥6.3T April 30 record). September BOJ meeting will test whether monetary policy can do what ¥15.4T could not. Takata dissent at 1.25% remains loudest hawkish signal. Rate gap with Fed (~250bps) unchanged regardless of BOJ move. Goldman path: Sep/Jan/Jul hikes to 1.75% terminal.
events_detected.source: TS2.tech, Reuters, BNN Bloomberg, FXStreet, Babypips, France24, RTL Today, BizToc
events_detected.trend_change: DETERIORATING — intervention effectiveness collapsing, strategy shift to covert speculator squeeze
